The prophet speaks for God.

walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] These words will shape your life.
Return and listen.

lost_path.text:
[TODO:de] Days of searching, hills of dust.
A servant says, "There is a seer here."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Press Onward
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Your search is more than donkeys.
Go to the seer.

pay_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Greater Than Coin
pay_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He has no need of your silver.
Go and hear his word.

anointing.text:
[TODO:de] Samuel pours oil and kisses you.
"The Lord has chosen you to lead."

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:de] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:de] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Bow First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The crown is heavy with calling.
Receive it in humility.

reject_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Do Not Refuse
reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] God Himself anoints through Samuel.
Receive what is given.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your hands rest open at your side.

assembly.text:
[TODO:de] Lots fall and your name is called.
The people search the camp.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] God will still bring you out.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Serve First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] A king of Israel serves the Lord.
Step forward humbly.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Found Among the Jars
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] They draw you out into the light.
Your calling cannot be hidden.

confirmation.text:
